verdict.rationale: Mesh is API-first, so it can run fully headless. Scoped, expirable API credentials are generated for programmatic access, and the complete workflow is exposed via API: screening (synchronous, asynchronous and batch), case and alert remediation, exports and transaction processing. Completion signals arrive by webhook, with idempotency headers. A published OpenAPI schema and Postman collection support scripted integration, so unattended automation is clearly supported. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific guidance (e.g., pipeline examples or test/sandbox mode for CI runs), and independent hands-on corroboration of authenticated headless runs.
